Command.Name: ELS
Command.Title: ELS | Basic Troubleshooting Guide
Command.Description:
Our Support Team recommends following the troubleshooting steps below if you are experiencing issues with the Emergency Lighting System (ELS) plugin.
**1. Script Hook V** Ensure you have the latest available version of Script Hook V installed. If you receive an ELS.asi error, please attach a screenshot of the error message when requesting support.
**2. Check Your ELS Configuration** If your emergency lights are not working correctly, ensure the vehicle `.xml` files are installed in your `GTA V/ELS/pack_default` folder. These files are usually included with the vehicle download.
**3. Check SirenSetting Limit Adjuster (SSLA)** If only certain lights are broken, or the ELS control panel opens using `Ctrl + P` but the lights do not work correctly, make sure you have the latest version of [SirenSetting Limit Adjuster](https://www.lcpdfr.com/downloads/gta5mods/scripts/28560-sirensetting-limit-adjuster/).
**4. Check ELS and DLS Compatibility** If you have DLS V2 installed and want to use both ELS and DLS, please refer to the relevant support command pinned in this channel for further guidance.
**Still experiencing issues?**
If none of these steps fixed your issue, please let us know below whilst attaching the following files to your message:
- `asiloader.log` - `ELS.log`
